units.source_text: 辰时出发，一行船舶向古人所咏叹的“浦上朝雾”中渐渐远去。

en.t: They set out at the hour of the dragon, and the boats gradually receded into the morning mist over the shore that poets of old had sung of.

units.source_text: 明石道人目送行舟，心中异常悲伤，久久不能自解，终至茫然若失。

en.t: The Akashi Novice watched the boats depart, his heart filled with extraordinary grief; for a long time he could not console himself, until at last he was left dazed and bereft.

units.source_text: 船里的尼姑夫人离开了这长年住惯的乡居而重返京都，也有无量感慨，

en.t: In the boat, the nun lady was leaving the country dwelling where she had lived for so many years and returning to Kyoto, and she too was overcome with countless feelings,
with tears streaming down her face, she recited this poem to her daughter:
